text:
Jordan: Hey team — new backend hire here, getting checkout-api wired up. Quick question: who is "owner" of secrets for a new service? Do I open a ticket, PR, or ask infra directly? Also what's the KMS key naming convention and rotation cadence? Thanks!

Maria: welcome! :wave: For app secrets we use team-owned Vault paths and a simple onboarding ticket. Use the secrets-provisioning queue. KMS keys follow: team/<team-name>/<env>/<service> as a human-friendly name, and we put the full key metadata in the ticket.

Sam: @Jordan I can provision the KMS key. I need the GCP project id and whether you want CMEK. Checklist: create key, grant service account kms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter, create Vault path at secret/data/teams/checkout/checkout-api, and add owners metadata.

Jordan: Thanks — project is redwood-prod, and yes we'd like CMEK. Question: how often do we rotate keys vs secrets? What's recommended?

Lina: Security perspective: rotate secrets (passwords, tokens) every 90d by default. KMS keys rotate yearly unless the service opts into quarterly rotation. Rotation steps: create new key version, update Vault to re-encrypt or re-wrap values, run smoke tests, then retire old version. We have automation (secret-rotate job) but it needs a ticket to opt in. Also remember to add explicit owners in Vault metadata, e.g. owners: @Jordan, @checkout-sre.

Maria: to make it concrete, file your onboarding ticket with a small YAML payload like this:

```
service: checkout-api
team: checkout
env: prod
secrets:
  - name: DB_PASSWORD
    path: secret/data/teams/checkout/checkout-api
    rotation: 90d
kms:
  project: redwood-prod
  key_ring: checkout-kr
  key_name: team-checkout-prod-checkout-api
```

Attach any PRs or infra requirements and tag "secrets-provisioning". That gets routed to infra for key creation and to devex for Vault path creation.

Sam: small note: prefer minting short-lived credentials where possible (service account impersonation) instead of long-lived secrets. If you must store creds, set rotation and owners.

Jordan: perfect. Who do I ping for emergency access if something breaks after hours?

Maria: ping #eng-oncall and cc @Lina for approvals. We also have an emergency-access flow (link in docs) — it opens a time-limited grant and requires a post-mortem within 24h.

Onboarding-bot: Automated: created ticket #3452 in secrets-provisioning for Jordan (checkout-api). Status: waiting for infra.

Sam: I'll pick up #3452 today. I'll DM you for the service account email and confirm CMEK settings :thumbsup:

Jordan: awesome, thanks everyone — adding owners to the ticket now.

Lina: welcome aboard. If you want, I can run a short 15-min checklist to validate least-privilege IAM and Vault ACLs.

Jordan: yes please, 15 min works — thank you! :smile:

Maria: added a brief "rotate secrets safely" guide to the ticket and a link to the rotate automation runbook.
